title: Stilbenoids from Vitis amurensis Bind to the GATA-3 DNA-Binding Domain and Inhibit the Transcription by GATA-3.
authors: Yu, Habin; Shah, Abdul Bari; Moon, Hyunjin; Kang, Minhee; Lee, Hyeonjun; Kim, Hyunsoo; Lee, Kyeong Seon; Byun, Youngjoo; Jung, Yong Woo; Lee, Ki Yong; Jeon, Young Ho
one_liner_zh: 该文研究山葡萄芪类化合物与转录因子GATA-3 DNA结合域的结合并抑制其转录，涉及蛋白-DNA互作界面与分子对接，但核心是药物筛选而非TF-DNA结合机制建模，方法以NMR和对接为主，AI/MD深度不足。
abstract: GATA-3 serves as a key transcription factor driving Th2 cell differentiation and allergic cytokine production. Identifying the natural modulators of GATA-3 could provide therapeutic opportunities for the regulation of allergic responses. This study aimed to identify Vitis amurensis-derived natural products with strong GATA-3 inhibition and to elucidate their binding modes and mechanisms of action. The DNA-binding domain 2 (DBD2) of human GATA-3 was analyzed by using NMR spectroscopy, including backbone assignment. Isolated natural compounds were screened for binding activity, followed by reporter gene assays to evaluate the transcriptional inhibition potential. Two-dimensional NMR and docking studies were conducted to characterize binding interactions and identify binding sites. Stilbenoids from V. amurensis showed specific binding to the DNA-binding domain of GATA-3, as detected by 2D NMR. Reporter gene assays revealed dose-dependent transcriptional inhibition by these compounds. One of the hit compounds, KUP149, exhibited two binding modes on DBD2 based on NMR data, both of which can disrupt GATA-3-DNA interactions. These findings suggest stilbene-based natural products as potential inhibitors of allergic immune responses via GATA-3 modulation.
abstract_zh: GATA-3是驱动Th2细胞分化和过敏性细胞因子产生的关键转录因子。识别GATA-3的天然调节因子可为调控过敏反应提供治疗机会。本研究旨在鉴定山葡萄（Vitis amurensis）来源的具有强效GATA-3抑制活性的天然产物，并阐明其结合模式和作用机制。利用核磁共振波谱（NMR spectroscopy）对人GATA-3的DNA结合域2（DBD2）进行分析，包括主链归属。对分离的天然化合物进行结合活性筛选，随后通过报告基因实验评估其转录抑制潜力。采用二维NMR和分子对接（docking）研究以表征结合相互作用并识别结合位点。二维NMR检测显示，山葡萄中的二苯乙烯类化合物（stilbenoids）与GATA-3的DNA结合域具有特异性结合。报告基因实验揭示这些化合物呈剂量依赖性转录抑制。其中一个命中化合物KUP149，基于NMR数据显示在DBD2上具有两种结合模式，两者均可破坏GATA-3-DNA相互作用。这些发现表明，基于二苯乙烯的天然产物可通过GATA-3调节作为过敏性免疫反应的潜在抑制剂。
